INNOVATION How does Ammonia OUR INNOVATION cracking work? APPROACH Ammonia cracking relies on separating ammonia molecules into nitrogen and hydrogen molecules. In practice, ammonia (NH₃) is fed in gaseous form into a catalytic cracking furnace heated to over 500°C. This very high-temperature process separates nitrogen (N₂) Innovation lies at the heart ofA ir Liquide’s and hydrogen (H₂) molecules. strategy. SCALING UP ELECTROLYSIS TO DECARBONIZE EUROPEAN INDUSTRY Renewable and low-carbon hydrogen TRAILBLAZER: AN INDUSTRIAL-SCALE is becoming a key lever for refineries and ELECTROLYZER AND LEARNING PLATFORM energy-intensive industries in Europe as IN GERMANY they work to comply with the European Trailblazer is Air Liquide’s first 20 MW proton exchange Union’s requirements and reduce the membrane (PEM) electrolyzer in Europe, the second for the carbon footprint of their processes. Group after the inauguration of Bécancour's production unit in 2021. Based in Oberhausen, in Germany, it is designed In this context, Air Liquide is deploying a as both an industrial facility and a full-scale demonstration series of large electrolysis projects across site. It produces renewable hydrogen for nearby industrial uses. major industrial basins, illustrating a progression from an initial 20 MW Beyond hydrogen production, Trailblazer functions as a industrial reference to facilities designed to platform to validate and optimize the performance of large PEM stacks. Operating data and feedback from the field operate at several hundred megawatts. are collected and shared between Air Liquide’s engineering teams and Siemens Energy, its partner in a joint venture dedicated to large-scale PEM electroyzer manufacturing. This continuous feedback led to concrete design adjustments in subsequent projects, including changes in equipment layout, the relocation of certain components and improved integration into Air Liquide-designed structures to simplify construction and maintenance. By combining production with learning, Trailblazer illustrates Air Liquide’s “innovation in action” approach – deploying technology at scale and using each asset to improve the next.
